description_en: Removes a database instance from Data Management (DMS)
description_zh: 调用deleteinstance接口，在DMS中删除指定实例
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise delete-instance --tid 3000 --host xxx.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --port 3306 --sid testSid --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to obtain the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的实例连接地址，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The port number that is used to connect to the database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to obtain the port number
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的实例连接端口，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The system ID (SID) of the database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to obtain the SID
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的实例SID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: sid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
